But the core OnlyFans problems came back and she waved them off, and no owner-level message has appeared in this chat for 30 days (last one Sep 16). Apologies'). She answered 'It’s fine he hasn’t noticed' / 'So just leave it!'. This is the 13th escalation since Jun 12, after frumby (Sep 23, still not followed up 23 days later) and a chatter Fred promised to remove on Jul 24 who is still unnamed 84 days on. A client telling us to 'just leave it' has stopped expecting a fix. That was Fred's only message this week. The Halloween plan she brought us on Oct 1 (10 sets, Teddi 'pays 1,000 per set') has still had no specific reply after 15 days. LINK IN BIO: on Oct 11 Mayson set up a new link-in-bio domain and told her 'it won’t get flagged and it’s completely safe'. On Oct 12 she wrote 'I just got flagged for my bio'. Mayson tagged Vivek three times. Vivek posted for the first time in 49 days ('Send logins'), she sent a screenshot and offered a login code, and he went silent again. On Oct 15 Mayson took the domain down and moved her to a direct link, which she accepted. Her question 'Is me being shadowbanned going to effect it at all?' is unanswered. Her August shadowban request is now 59 days old. WHAT IMPROVED: Melissa had a strong week. She sent the DMCA breakdown on time again (Oct 9), sent a written two-week earnings and performance report (Oct 9), put one of her reels across a 23-account repost network (Oct 13) and ran a call (Oct 15). Stephski's billing fixes landed: the day-before withdrawal reminder went out (Oct 13), the Oct 1-14 invoice went out on cadence (Oct 15), and the 'pausing in work' line is gone. MONEY: she said 'I’ll get it paid today!' on Oct 15. Payment is not confirmed by window close. The $27 she still owed from Oct 6 has never been confirmed. ALTR still has not stated a received amount in chat for any invoice. CHURN SIGNALS: (1) owner-level silence has crossed 30 days. That threshold is hit. (2) No results question was deflected to a call. Melissa's written earnings report counts against this signal, but the Oct 15 call, like the Oct 5 and Sep 8 calls, has no written recap. (3) Long-promised deliverables still have no written proof: the named chatter (84 days), the purchase-history check, TikTok (59 days), the account map, Teddi's CRM notes and the owner's IG phone-farm update. That threshold is hit. (4) Billing was 4 of 25 ALTR messages, so it is not the majority. Her asks rose from 1 to 3, but one of them she withdrew herself ('just leave it').

health.rationale: 49, essentially flat from 48. Operationally ALTR improved. Melissa delivered the DMCA breakdown on time, a written two-week earnings and performance report, a 23-account reel repost and a call. Stephski fixed the billing template: the day-before reminder was sent Oct 13, the invoice went out on cadence Oct 15 and the pausing line was removed. Billing fell from half of ALTR's messages to 4 of 25. Her asks rose from 1 to 3. Pulling the other way: (a) The old-content mis-send recurred with a new spender, Matt, on Oct 13, and she told Fred 'So just leave it!'. That is lowered expectations from a client who has escalated this 13 times, not a fix. Fred posted 1 message all week and still nothing on frumby (23 days), the chatter promised removal on Jul 24 (84 days) or the Halloween plan (15 days). (b) The link-in-bio domain ALTR promised 'won’t get flagged' got her flagged within a day. Vivek resurfaced after 49 days with 'Send logins', then went silent after she supplied access, and her shadowban question went unanswered. (c) No receipts for any payment. The $27 from Oct 6 is unconfirmed and the $192 gap is 52 days old. Explicit churn signals: Signal 1 is PRESENT. The last owner-level message in this chat was 2026-09-16, 30 days before window close. Signal 3 is PRESENT. There is no written proof of the named chatter, purchase-history check, TikTok shadowban check, Teddi CRM notes, account map or IG phone-farm update. Signal 2 is NOT present: no results question was deflected to a call, and Melissa sent a written earnings report. The Oct 15 call has no written recap, so we are watching that. Signal 4 is NOT present: billing was 4 of 25 ALTR messages. Her warm tone and fast payment are not counted as health here. Her asks rising off the floor (1 to 3) is the main thing keeping this from dropping further.
